review_kind: cold review of committed publication candidate

findings.finding: The acceptance check accepts successful validation receipts without comparing their tested-source manifests to the measured source manifest, so it can mark evidence complete when the suite ran against different inputs.
findings.disposition: Hari authorized a source-map binding, matching/mismatched regression test, one more acceptance pass and one more cold review. The source-map correction and support tests are included. The original validation and mutation inputs are unchanged; the next cold review remains required before publication.
